summary: Implementation plan for AHSG Cosmos Lab: a theoretical paper companion and interactive physics simulation suite for the Anisotropic Higgs-Soup Genesis cosmological model. Features interactive step-by-step mathematical derivations, 2D dynamic cosmological cross-section visualizer with magnetic dipole boundary, real-time observational chart engine (SGWB/LISA, CMB rings, B-field redshifting), and consistency audit dashboard.
